Tugas-Pertemuan-2

Pendahuluan

Tugas ini menerapkan metode pemulusan Single Moving Average (SMA), Double Moving Average (DMA), Single Exponential Smoothing (SES), dan Double Exponential Smoothing (DES) pada data time series Beijing Air Quality (kolom Periode dan Count).

Sesuai pembagian kelompok, data yang dianalisis adalah periode 777 sampai 970

Library yang Digunakan

library(rio)        
library(forecast)
library(TTR)         
library(ggplot2)

Impor dan Pembagian Data

data <- import("Beijing_Air_Quality_Rapi.csv")
colnames(data) <- c("Periode", "Count")

data_darell <- data[data$Periode >= 777 & data$Periode <= 970, ]
row.names(data_darell) <- NULL

dim(data_darell)
## [1] 194   2
head(data_darell)
##   Periode Count
## 1     777   248
## 2     778   264
## 3     779   264
## 4     780   250
## 5     781   262
## 6     782   262
tail(data_darell)
##     Periode Count
## 189     965   258
## 190     966   250
## 191     967   255
## 192     968   263
## 193     969   259
## 194     970   256
# Ubah jadi objek time series
data_darell.ts <- ts(data_darell$Count)
summary(data_darell.ts)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##   160.0   250.2   259.0   251.9   262.0   264.0

Eksplorasi Data

ts.plot(data_darell.ts, xlab = "Periode", ylab = "Count",
        main = "Plot Data Air Quality (Periode 777-970)")
points(data_darell.ts)

Pola data terlihat relatif stasioner di sekitar nilai rata-ratanya (tidak menunjukkan tren naik/turun yang tajam).

Pembagian Data Latih dan Data Uji

n <- nrow(data_darell)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)
n_test  <- n - n_train

training <- data_darell[1:n_train, ]
testing  <- data_darell[(n_train + 1):n, ]

train.ts <- ts(training$Count)
test.ts  <- ts(testing$Count)

c(n_total = n, n_train = n_train, n_test = n_test)
## n_total n_train  n_test 
##     194     155      39
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = training, aes(x = Periode, y = Count, col = "Data Latih")) +
  geom_line(data = testing, aes(x = Periode, y = Count, col = "Data Uji")) +
  labs(x = "Periode", y = "Count", color = "Keterangan") +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Keterangan:", breaks = c("Data Latih", "Data Uji"),
                      values = c("blue", "red")) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Fungsi Bantu Perhitungan Akurasi

hitung_akurasi <- function(aktual, ramalan) {
  error <- aktual - ramalan
  SSE  <- sum(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  MSE  <- mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  RMSE <- sqrt(MSE)
  MAPE <- mean(abs(error / aktual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  c(SSE = SSE, MSE = MSE, RMSE = RMSE, MAPE = MAPE)
}

Metode 1: Single Moving Average (SMA)

Digunakan parameter m = 4.

data.sma <- SMA(train.ts, n = 4)
data.ramal <- c(NA, data.sma)       
fitted_sma_train <- data.ramal[1:length(train.ts)]

akurasi_train_sma <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(train.ts), fitted_sma_train)

ramalan_sma_test <- rep(data.sma[length(data.sma)], n_test)
akurasi_test_sma <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(test.ts), ramalan_sma_test)

rbind(Latih = akurasi_train_sma, Uji = akurasi_test_sma)
##            SSE       MSE      RMSE     MAPE
## Latih 85344.12 565.19288 23.773786 6.931924
## Uji    3362.00  86.20513  9.284672 2.426992
ts.plot(data_darell.ts, xlab = "Periode", ylab = "Count", main = "SMA (m=4)")
points(data_darell.ts)
lines(c(fitted_sma_train, rep(NA, n_test)), col = "green", lwd = 2)
lines(c(rep(NA, n_train), ramalan_sma_test), col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft", c("Aktual", "Pemulusan", "Ramalan"), lty = 1,
       col = c("black", "green", "red"), cex = 0.7)

Metode 2: Double Moving Average (DMA)

Digunakan parameter m = 4, dengan pemulusan rata-rata dilakukan dua kali.

dma <- SMA(data.sma, n = 4)
At  <- 2 * data.sma - dma
Bt  <- 2 / (4 - 1) * (data.sma - dma)

data.ramal2 <- c(NA, At + Bt)
fitted_dma_train <- data.ramal2[1:length(train.ts)]

akurasi_train_dma <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(train.ts), fitted_dma_train)

h <- 1:n_test
ramalan_dma_test <- At[length(At)] + Bt[length(Bt)] * h
akurasi_test_dma <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(test.ts), ramalan_dma_test)

rbind(Latih = akurasi_train_dma, Uji = akurasi_test_dma)
##             SSE      MSE     RMSE     MAPE
## Latih 130829.70 883.9845 29.73188 9.166697
## Uji    13008.94 333.5625 18.26369 5.983916
ts.plot(data_darell.ts, xlab = "Periode", ylab = "Count", main = "DMA (m=4)")
points(data_darell.ts)
lines(c(fitted_dma_train, rep(NA, n_test)), col = "green", lwd = 2)
lines(c(rep(NA, n_train), ramalan_dma_test), col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft", c("Aktual", "Pemulusan", "Ramalan"), lty = 1,
       col = c("black", "green", "red"), cex = 0.7)

Metode 3: Single Exponential Smoothing (SES)

Parameter alpha dioptimalkan otomatis (alpha = NULL).

ses.opt <- HoltWinters(train.ts, gamma = FALSE, beta = FALSE, alpha = NULL)
ses.opt$alpha
## [1] 0.00694863
n_na_ses <- length(train.ts) - nrow(ses.opt$fitted)
fitted_ses_train <- c(rep(NA, n_na_ses), ses.opt$fitted[, 1])
akurasi_train_ses <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(train.ts), fitted_ses_train)

ramalan_ses <- forecast(ses.opt, h = n_test)
akurasi_test_ses <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(test.ts), as.numeric(ramalan_ses$mean))

rbind(Latih = akurasi_train_ses, Uji = akurasi_test_ses)
##             SSE       MSE      RMSE     MAPE
## Latih 67751.522 439.94495 20.974865 6.600162
## Uji    3630.693  93.09469  9.648559 3.470961
plot(ses.opt, main = "SES - alpha optimum")

Metode 4: Double Exponential Smoothing (DES)

Parameter alpha dan beta dioptimalkan otomatis.

des.opt <- HoltWinters(train.ts, gamma = FALSE)
c(alpha = des.opt$alpha, beta = des.opt$beta)
## alpha.alpha   beta.beta 
##   0.3765468   0.1210015
n_na_des <- length(train.ts) - nrow(des.opt$fitted)
fitted_des_train <- c(rep(NA, n_na_des), des.opt$fitted[, 1])
akurasi_train_des <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(train.ts), fitted_des_train)

ramalan_des <- forecast(des.opt, h = n_test)
akurasi_test_des <- hitung_akurasi(as.numeric(test.ts), as.numeric(ramalan_des$mean))

rbind(Latih = akurasi_train_des, Uji = akurasi_test_des)
##            SSE      MSE     RMSE     MAPE
## Latih 95861.54 626.5460 25.03090 7.120528
## Uji   14736.58 377.8611 19.43865 6.410667
plot(des.opt, main = "DES - alpha & beta optimum")

Perbandingan Akurasi dan Kesimpulan

tabel_akurasi_train <- rbind(SMA = akurasi_train_sma, DMA = akurasi_train_dma,
                             SES = akurasi_train_ses, DES = akurasi_train_des)
tabel_akurasi_test  <- rbind(SMA = akurasi_test_sma, DMA = akurasi_test_dma,
                             SES = akurasi_test_ses, DES = akurasi_test_des)

cat("Akurasi Data Latih:\n")
## Akurasi Data Latih:
round(tabel_akurasi_train, 4)
##           SSE      MSE    RMSE   MAPE
## SMA  85344.12 565.1929 23.7738 6.9319
## DMA 130829.70 883.9845 29.7319 9.1667
## SES  67751.52 439.9449 20.9749 6.6002
## DES  95861.54 626.5460 25.0309 7.1205
cat("\nAkurasi Data Uji:\n")
## 
## Akurasi Data Uji:
round(tabel_akurasi_test, 4)
##           SSE      MSE    RMSE   MAPE
## SMA  3362.000  86.2051  9.2847 2.4270
## DMA 13008.938 333.5625 18.2637 5.9839
## SES  3630.693  93.0947  9.6486 3.4710
## DES 14736.582 377.8611 19.4386 6.4107
metode_terbaik <- rownames(tabel_akurasi_test)[which.min(tabel_akurasi_test[, "MSE"])]
ts.plot(data_darell.ts, xlab = "Periode", ylab = "Count",
        main = "Perbandingan Ramalan Data Uji Keempat Metode")
points(data_darell.ts)
lines((n_train + 1):n, ramalan_sma_test, col = "red", lwd = 2)
lines((n_train + 1):n, ramalan_dma_test, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines((n_train + 1):n, as.numeric(ramalan_ses$mean), col = "green", lwd = 2)
lines((n_train + 1):n, as.numeric(ramalan_des$mean), col = "purple", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft", c("Aktual", "SMA", "DMA", "SES", "DES"), lty = 1,
       col = c("black", "red", "blue", "green", "purple"), cex = 0.7)

Berdasarkan nilai MSE pada data uji, metode dengan performa terbaik untuk data ini adalah SMA, karena menghasilkan nilai SSE, MSE, RMSE, dan MAPE yang paling kecil dibandingkan tiga metode lainnya (lihat tabel akurasi data uji di atas).
